Sandbox沙箱

A frozen mini-internet makes deep research reproducible.一个冻结的迷你互联网让深度研究可复现。

Agents browse a controlled stack instead of the live web. That makes every task rerunnable, every source reachable, and every citation audit possible.智能体浏览的是受控的栈，而非真实的互联网。这让每个任务都可重跑、每个来源都可访问、每条引用都可审计。

Why not the live web?为什么不用真实的互联网？

Live pages drift, search results personalize, and citations disappear. The sandbox trades breadth for auditability: each agent sees the same world, and each verifier can re-open the cited evidence.真实页面会漂移变化，搜索结果会因人而异，引用也会失效消失。沙箱以广度换取可审计性：每个智能体面对同一个世界，每个校验器都能重新打开被引用的证据。

Why keep web-shaped APIs?为什么保留类网页的 API？

Most deep-research frameworks already know Tavily, Firecrawl, and OpenAI-compatible chat endpoints. The shim lets them run against the benchmark with adapter code measured in dozens of lines.大多数 Deep Research 框架已经熟悉 Tavily、Firecrawl 以及兼容 OpenAI 的对话接口。垫片让它们只需数十行适配代码即可在该基准上运行。

Deep Research Arena

A reproducible benchmark for deep-research agents: frozen tasks, auditable reports, jury decisions, and judge-free citation checks. Fluency is not grounding.一项可复现的深度研究智能体基准：冻结任务、可审计报告、陪审团裁决与不依赖判官的引用核验。流畅不等于接地。
